Assumptions, Scenario, Capacity History, Population and EU-27 Population hold parameter values only. Every result (operating cost, material revenue, recovery, EBITDA, sensitivities, retirement and per-capita figures, per-MW values, silver content, cell powder scenarios) is calculated by the program from these values. Two exceptions with live formulas: Product Value, and Assumptions Section 8 (mass share of module, and the theoretical silver content upper limit in % and g/t = silver ÷ (silver + flagged component shares)).

The program updates the silver, aluminium, copper and silicon prices in Assumptions Section 5 every Monday: silver spot (XAG/USD, per troy ounce), LME aluminium and LME copper (USD per metric ton), SMM silicon metal East China #553 (USD per metric ton). Every calculation, including the cell powder scenarios, reads these four prices; no price is stored twice.
Shredding (code SHREDDING, formerly CONVENTIONAL), Thermal processing (HOT_KNIFE), PV Circulator (PVCIRCULATOR).
Annual panels = panels per month × 12. Annual input (t) = annual panels × panel weight × 0.45359237 ÷ 1000. Operating days per month = working weeks × working days per week ÷ 12.

Capacity per shift = capacity × hours × days. Shifts = MAX(1, ROUNDUP(panels per month ÷ capacity per shift)). Lines = MAX(1, ROUNDUP(shifts ÷ 3)). Labor = operators × wage × hours × days × 12 × shifts; burden and workers' compensation = labor × rate. Facility = (equipment space × lines + storage space) × sq.ft. per m² × (rent + CAM). Storage = ROUNDUP(annual panels ÷ working weeks × storage weeks ÷ panels per pallet) × pallet footprint × (1 + aisle) ÷ stack levels. Electricity = annual panels × kWh per panel × price. Consumables = annual panels × USD per panel. Maintenance = capex × lines × rate. Packaging = annual panels × USD per panel. Handling, insurance and admin are annual amounts. Secondary treatment = residual (t) × short tons per t × landfill cost.

Input by material = annual input × share. Recovered = input × recovery rate. Revenue = recovered × price (USD per t; USD per lb × 2,204.6226) × realization × saleable. Residual = input − recovered. Recovery rate = recovered ÷ input. Silver revenue, aluminium + copper revenue and other recovered materials are the sums of the matching materials. Residual treatment cost = residual (t) × 1.10231131 × landfill cost (California business waste landfill, Assumptions Section 1). Product Value nets this cost against the product value on the Residual / mixed fraction row.

Material revenue = sum of material revenues. EBITDA = material revenue − operating cost. Capex = capex per line × lines. Per-panel cost = cost ÷ annual panels. Fee sensitivity: EBITDA + fee × annual panels × panel weight (lb). Silver sensitivity: EBITDA + change × silver revenue. Per MW = per-panel value × panels per MW (1,000,000 W ÷ panel rating).

Weibull CDF F(a) = 1 − EXP(−(a/T)^shape). Retired(t) = Σ New(v) × [F(t−v) − F(t−v−1)] for v < t. New(t) = MAX(0, Cumulative(t) − Cumulative(t−1) + Retired(t)). Capacity for 2025–2049 = constant annual growth from 2024 to 2050. Other markets = World − the six markets. Per-capita kg = Retired GW × 1,000 × kg per MW ÷ population; kg per MW = panel weight × 1,000,000 ÷ panel rating.

Theoretical silver content of a route product = silver share of module ÷ (mass share of the components in the product + silver share), with all module silver assumed to be in the product. Components in each product are the 1/0 flags in Assumptions Section 8. Shredding: 0.05 ÷ (82.2 + 0.05) = 0.0608% (608 g/t). Thermal processing: 0.05 ÷ (12.2 + 0.05) = 0.408% (4,082 g/t). PV Circulator cell powder: 0.05 ÷ (3.5 + 0.05) = 1.408% (14,085 g/t). The Elkem measurement (Ag 1.5% of cell powder; Ag ÷ (Si + Ag) = 2.19%) is the comparison value for the PV Circulator.

Cell powder consists of silicon and silver. Copper is in the busbar, not in the powder; aluminium in the powder is not counted and affects only the silver purification cost. Silicon in powder = silicon in module × annual input × silicon recovery; silver in powder = silver in module × annual input × silver recovery; powder = silicon + silver. Silver price per metric ton = USD per troy ounce ÷ grams per troy ounce × 1,000,000. Scenario 1 revenue = silver and silicon in powder × price × PV Circulator realization. Scenario 2 revenue = refined silver and silicon × price × refining realization. Reagents: H2SO4 = Ag × M(H2SO4)/(2×M(Ag)); H2O2 = Ag × M(H2O2)/(2×M(Ag)) × (1 + excess); copper to cement silver = Ag × M(Cu)/(2×M(Ag)); aluminium to cement that copper = copper × 2×M(Al)/(3×M(Cu)); HNO3 = Ag × 4×M(HNO3)/(3×M(Ag)); electrorefining kWh = Ag mol × Faraday ÷ 3,600 ÷ efficiency × voltage ÷ 1,000. Reagent cost = tonnes ÷ concentration × price.
